strategies.title: ReUI Integration
strategies.content: ReUI registered as on-demand remote MCP server at https://mcp.reui.io with official skill in .agents/skills/reui and /reui workflow.

strategies.title: Antigravity Workflow Frontmatter Contract & Global Discovery
strategies.content: All Antigravity workflows must contain description-only YAML frontmatter matching their file stems without disable-model-invocation or metadata tags. Global workflows must be synchronized to ~/.gemini/antigravity-ide/global_workflows/. Major executions must auto-run /learn and finish with a quick /grill-me.

strategies.title: Auto-Learn Trigger Scope High-Threshold Invariant
strategies.content: Post-execution Auto-Learn + quick Grill-Me is scoped strictly to high-threshold major executions (multi-file feature builds, architectural changes, /build-feature, /ship), omitting single-query turns.

strategies.title: Pre-Execution Tool Optimization Protocol & Decision Matrix
strategies.content: Before taking any action, determine the optimal tool primitive that minimizes tokens and time (grep_search for search, full view_file for inspection, multi_replace_file_content for batch edits, sync run_command for test/build, reactive wakeup for async tasks).

strategies.title: Context-Driven Workflow Adaptation with Lean On-Demand Loading
strategies.content: Autonomously adapt specialized ZeroGravity workflows when tasks align with their domain (/webperf, /debug, /design-ui, /reach, /yagni-simplify, /spec, /ship). Load on-demand in a single view_file call without preloading or bloating context tokens.

strategies.title: Native Integrated Tools Over Python Subprocesses
strategies.content: Use native integrated tools (view_file, write_to_file, replace_file_content, multi_replace_file_content, grep_search, ask_question) for all internal agent memory, context, checklist, and configuration operations instead of executing internal Python scripts (analyze.py, auto_evolve.py, checklist.py, harness.py, ki_injector.py, learn.py, mcp.py, session_manager.py, summarizer.py, sync_knowledge.py). Conserves tokens, eliminates subprocess latency, and ensures atomic operations.

strategies.title: Context-Driven Skill Auto-Activation
strategies.content: Autonomously identify and inspect matching available skills (SKILL.md) via single whole-file view_file call before executing specialized tasks (e.g. Chrome DevTools, accessibility, Hugging Face CLI, ponytail debt, performance, security). Eliminates ad-hoc guesswork and ensures compliance with official tool runbooks.
